title: Chapter 75 Threat
content:
Chapter 75 Threat

The first person to rush up was Fan Chengyang.

"Brother Wang, you are indeed here. You are fine!" Fan Chengyang forced a smile on his face, his tone was a little strange.

However, he is smiling but not smiling.

This group of people broke into the store directly and went straight to the second floor. They didn't take the store owner seriously at all.

This made Li Youcai furious.

"What do you want to do? Who gave you the courage?" he yelled.

Fan Chengyang didn't say anything, but silently made way for a passage.

In Nanshanji, everyone knew that Li's grocery store had a background that no one would dare to mess with.

But now Fan Chengyang has just found a backer who can ignore Li Youcai.

Yesterday, he wanted to become a core member of the Wild Wolf Gang. Today, he already looked down on the Wild Wolf Gang.

He also wanted to thank Wang Shuo for giving him a chance to climb up to Ni Wu.

At this time, Ni Wu walked out of the crowd.

"The courage I gave you is enough."

His voice was very low, not angry or authoritative.

Ni Wu was wearing a sky blue robe, and his sharp eyes were hidden under his stern face.

When Li Youcai saw this person, he twisted his eyebrows and was stunned for a moment. Then he was horrified and said in a trembling voice: "Ni, Ni Wu..."

Wang Shuo felt uneasy after hearing this. Judging from the reactions of Dongfang Ling and Xie Fan yesterday, this person should be difficult to deal with.

The Eye of Deception is activated.

Only the name can be viewed, and no other information can be viewed.

The level difference is at least 10 levels.

"Agui, you may have seen through this person."

"Back to Lord Lord, this person is level 30."

The visitor is not good!

Although Wang Shuo was a little nervous, he didn't feel too scared when he thought that combat was prohibited in Nanshanji, the level 60 guards were not vegetarians, and he still had resurrection coins.

"Your name is Wang Shuo?" Ni Wu looked at Wang Shuo with a fierce gaze that could pierce someone.

"I am, what's the matter with you?" Wang Shuo said in a neither humble nor overbearing tone. Ayub and Gong Zheng were also silently on guard to prevent the other party from making an attack.

"Where is Dongfang Ling?"

"I don't know, we separated last night!" Wang Shuo said truthfully.

The other party really wanted to capture Dongfang Ling.

"I know she left. I want to ask her where she went after she left?" Ni Wu said impatiently.

"I have no idea."

Ni Wu frowned when he saw Wang Shuo's lack of energy. He took out the iron sword in his hand and returned it to its sheath in the blink of an eye.

Just when everyone didn't know why.

The large bronze shield on one side of the wall was split in half directly from the middle.

"If there is any news about her, inform Fan Chengyang immediately." His voice was very calm, without any hint of threat, but it was full of undeniable flavor.

After saying that, Ni Wu turned and left.

During the whole process, Li Youcai was not even glanced at.

"Brother Wang, if there is any news about Dongfang Ling, you can come to me at the Iron Sword Gate!" Fan Chengyang said with a smile, and looked at Ayub again, not too presumptuous.

Wang Shuo's face darkened, and anger surged uncontrollably in his heart.

It was obvious that he had been betrayed by Fan Chengyang.

Yesterday, he invited himself to join the Wild Wolf Gang, but today he has become the lackey of the Iron Sword Sect. He is really a person with no bottom line.

Wang Shuo silently wrote down Fan Chengyang's name on the "diary page".

The frightened Li Youcai saw that everyone in the Iron Sword Sect had left, so he slumped down on a chair and took a sip of tea to calm down his shock!

"Boss Li, aren't you so afraid of him?" Wang Shuo asked softly when he saw Li Youcai's embarrassed look.

Li Youcai also realized that he had lost his composure and coughed softly.

After calming down, he solemnly said: "Oh! My Lord King, you don't know his reputation. In the entire Shenwu Empire, among the younger generation, there are only a handful of people who can challenge him."

"Moreover, this man is ruthless and ruthless, killing people without batting an eyelid. To put it bluntly, I'm afraid you've never seen more people than he has killed."

"Is it so fierce?"

Hearing Li Youcai's words, Wang Shuo's heart suddenly jumped and he couldn't help but raise his danger level again!

"The business between us is temporarily unavailable. I hope Lord Wang can understand." Li Youcai said with apology.
